description: The bar chart illustrates the runtime comparison of various models in a streaming environment, with the horizontal axis listing the model names in the order of "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude", and the vertical axis labeled "Runtime (seconds)" ranging from 0 to 400 in increments of 50. The bars are colored according to the legend, with "Our Joint Framework" represented by a green bar and the other models, categorized as "LLM Models", represented by light blue bars. The runtime values for each model are as follows: "Our Joint Framework" has a runtime of 77 seconds, "ChatGPT" has a runtime of 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" has a runtime of 365 seconds, "LLaMA" has a runtime of 172 seconds, and "Claude" has a runtime of 243 seconds, with the bars not being sorted in any particular order. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the runtime comparison among the different models, with "Our Joint Framework" having the shortest runtime and "DeepSeek" having the longest runtime.
